title: Vocalists, jive singers and the first scat singers
summary: He says bands did not need a vocalist, and names Gertie Saunders as an early scat singer.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Now, tell me, at this point did most of the bands, did you feel that you had to have a vocalist?
Well you didn't necessarily have to have a vocalist because a lot of the men were jive singers, what you call jive singers.

Like, 'Three little words --', (sings), it was the beginning of rhythm da da da da da - it was more rhythm singing too. Because the first rhythm singer -- it all happened in the early twenties, Chris, like, in the early twenties we had the first scat singer come Vaudeville Performers.
through there was, uh, Florence Mills took her place in the show. Was Gertie Saunders. Gertie Saunders.
